what: Each title letter is laid flat 90° on the x-axis and hidden 30px below. Once it reaches 20% below screen center (or right on open), the letters stand up one by one from the first at .03s intervals over 1.2s — they appear flipping upward like pages being stood up

options.delay: First-letter delay (seconds), default .1 — Brand hero .8 (second line 1, on a day when loading is skipped 2·2.2), section large title .4
options.shift: Initial offset distance, default 30px — Brand hero 2.0833vw, about big heading 4.1667vw
options.ease: Curve, default 0.19,1,0.22,1 — big About title 0.165,0.84,0.44,1 · GSAP names keep their parentheses (brand elastic.out(1, 0.3))
options.on: If 「load」, it starts right away without waiting to be visible
options.fade: Opacity fade-in duration (s), default same as dur — Brand .4
options.fade-ease: Opacity curve, same as the default ease — Brand 0.25,0.46,0.45,0.9
options.origin: Rotation axis (transform-origin), default center — Brand bottom (flips up around the bottom edge)
options.tilt: Initial tilt angle (°), default 90 — 0 means no tilting, it only floats up (Brand)
options.shift-x: Distance initially pushed sideways, default 0 — vertical-writing title at -15% (enters from the side)

use: Your one line, with more heat.
note: Splits text into characters instead of grouping into words — use it on one-line titles like the original. For multi-line Korean body text a line break can land mid-word, so give each line its own element
